edge_case_matrix.risk: A regression appears with no approver, notes, or cause.
edge_case_matrix.expected: Fail every non-D-RT override missing a cause, approver, or notes.

edge_case_matrix.risk: Teams invent free-form causes that cannot be analysed later.
edge_case_matrix.expected: Fail any cause outside the four enumerated categories.

edge_case_matrix.risk: A FIXED criterion uses the DYNAMIC-only no-approver path.
edge_case_matrix.expected: Fail D-RT unless criterion tag is DYNAMIC and cause is rubric-tightened.

edge_case_matrix.risk: An audit reaches SIGNED while a regression remains unresolved.
edge_case_matrix.expected: Fail signed samples containing UNRESOLVED rows.

edge_case_matrix.risk: The old no-downgrade rule name creeps back into active doctrine.
edge_case_matrix.expected: Fail old-rule wording outside explicit backward-compatibility text.

edge_case_matrix.risk: New audit reports cannot carry regression tags.
edge_case_matrix.expected: Fail if `regression_tag` or `override_log` disappears from the template.

edge_case_matrix.risk: A batch-level drop is hidden because individual rows look acceptable.
edge_case_matrix.expected: Require batch-level regression language in template, prompt, and FIX-cycle docs.
Require §6 execution log, cause category, notes, and rollback/override branch.

docs/framework/05-regression-policy.md: Regressions are allowed only when they are visible, attributed, and signed.
Older audits with `no_downgrade: true` remain valid
docs/framework/04-maturity-tiers.md: DSAF Level transitions and the no-silent-regression rule
every regression in a signed audit is surfaced with a cause, tag, and approval path
docs/guidelines/prompts/fix-mode.md: Do not auto-revert. Rollback is a human decision.

sample_override_cases.notes: External WCAG reference changed and is cited in the audit.
Bundle budget was relaxed for a documented measurement feature and has a follow-up.
Vendor API change caused the regression and the new version is cited.
